summary: Read three integers meaning, in order, the day, the month, and the year. The date is always a valid Gregorian day, and the year is between 1971 and 2100. Decide which weekday that date falls on. The written name must be one of Sunday or Monday or Tuesday or Wednesday or Thursday or Friday or Saturday. Apply Gregorian leap-year rules, so February may contain 29 days. The latest permitted year is 2100.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
